structured.reason: The description contains minimizing reassurances that address complaints raised in the reviews. "The wrinkle-resistant, washable material holds its shape wash after wash" responds to the reviewer who said the masks "will wear out through washing faster as they fray." "Wear it for extended periods without discomfort" responds to reviewers reporting heat, breathing difficulty, and discomfort. "helping it sit neatly through the day" and "keeps the fabric away from your nose and mouth" respond to the fit and breathing complaints. Under the strict standard, reassurance that answers a known complaint counts as a negative signal, so the description fails. The reference to "thin" fabric is a neutral spec and is not the basis for this failure.
